text:
alex: Heads-up — customer reported repeated 502/504s during a burst at ~18:12 UTC. Support ticket #23456. Gateway logs show scaleup lag + many queued requests :eyes:
priya: Sharing relevant tails and excerpts from gateway/KEDA/pod logs below
alex: ```
2026-03-16T18:12:34Z gateway ERROR 504 req=req-9f3b backend timeout after 30s
2026-03-16T18:12:36Z keda ScaledObject poll interval=30s cooldown=300s lastScale=2026-03-16T18:10:05Z
pod product-inference-7: init container model-init took 120s -> readiness=false
```
jason: Sounds like pods are not Ready fast enough after KEDA/HPA decide to scale. HPA min=1, KEDA allows min=0 in the ScaledObject so there's a coldstart gap
priya: KEDA ScaledObject annotations: targetQueueLength=100, pollingInterval=30s, cooldownPeriod=300s, prewarmAnnotation=false. That pollingInterval means we only react every 30s
sasha: Repro steps from support: ramp 50 req/s for 30s -> gateway returns 504s and queue spikes. Customer is on hosted plan so can't pin Dedicated capacity
alex: @oncall-bot can you open an incident and page infra? We need help triaging readiness thresholds + warm cache settings
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-234 opened. Paging infra:oncall now.
infra-bot: Acknowledged. Can we get autoscaler & queue metrics for 18:00-18:20 window?
jason: Pasting aggregated metrics (18:00-18:20):
```
queue_length: spike to 800 at 18:12:20
desired_replicas: 2 -> 16 (jump completed by 18:13:50)
ready_replicas: 2 -> 3 in first 60s after scale, then ramp to 12 over next 90s
model_init_time: median=95s, p95=210s
```
priya: So the autoscaler does increase desired replicas, but model_init/warm cache dominates readiness. KEDA poll interval + cooldown also slow reactivity for short bursts
sasha: Short-term mitigation ideas: enable prewarm annotations for high-burst tenants, reduce readinessProbe.initialDelaySeconds where safe, and increase burst capacity window in the autoscaler to avoid oscillation
jason: Long-term: async model loading, keep-warm pool, or sticky warm instances. Also instrument model-init times per image to inform autoscaler profiles
priya: For immediate repro, support suggested traffic script: ```hey -n 2000 -c 50 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"```
sasha: Also noticed a handful of 401s during the spike (token refresh failures) — auth team might explain some errors but the bulk are 504 gateway timeouts
alex: ACTIONS: jason -> apply prewarm for tenant (ETA 15m), priya -> tune KEDA polling/cooldown for burst tier (ETA 60m), sasha -> coordinate with auth team re: token refresh (ETA 30m). Update here when done
infra-bot: Applying tenant prewarm flag now (acme-tenant: prewarm=true). Deployment id=deploy-7788 at 18:32
jason: Patch applied. Observed ready_replicas increase to 12 within ~20s of patch; queue started draining. Customer reports far fewer 504s :tada:
priya: I'll open PR to default pollingInterval=10s for high-burst tier and add a config knob for cooldown tuning per tenant. Also proposing telemetry alert: model_init_p95 > 120s -> mark tenant as warm-pool candidate
sasha: I'll loop in auth team for the token refresh failures and correlate logs. We'll keep the ticket open until PR merged + runbook published
alex: Thanks all. I'll draft a short customer postmortem & include mitigation steps. Will attach repro steps and metrics. Keep this thread updated.
